name: Commerce NZ
description: New Zealand customisations for Drupal Commerce. Currently ships a single feature: a New Zealand GST/IRD tax number type (plugin 'new_zealand_gst') for Commerce Tax that validates NZ IRD numbers with the official modulo-11 checksum. No configuration, routes, permissions, or payment logic.
project_description:
At the moment this module just contains a New Zealand GST tax number validator - see https://www.drupal.org/project/commerce/issues/2874149 for details.

 If you create more Commerce NZ specific items please add them to this module.
